actions.label:    Wi-Fi
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then nmcli radio wifi on; else nmcli radio wifi off; fi'
actions.update_command: sh -c '[ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = enabled ] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label:    Bluetooth
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then bluetoothctl power on; else bluetoothctl power off; fi'
actions.update_command: sh -c 'bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.label:    Night light
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then wlsunset -T 6000 -t 3500 -S 07:00 -s 19:00 & else pkill -x wlsunset; fi'
actions.update_command: sh -c 'pgrep -x wlsunset >/dev/null && echo true || echo false'
